purpose: Maintain five actual starting vassals of Chu without changing map geometry.

worldview.EGU: E, the eastern bronze-and-river gateway around Wuchang and Xingguo
worldview.QVN: Quan, restored around Anlu and Jingmen on the middle Han corridor
worldview.ZHU: Zhou, restored in the Mianyang-Jianli lake and marsh country
worldview.CSA: Changsha, the southern Chu cadet state around the Xiang River
worldview.ACG: Ancheng, a restored marquisate around Anfu on Chu's Jiangxi frontier

invariants.culture_and_religion: existing local cultures retained (gdd_chu; Ancheng gdd_gan), all subjects remain Confucian
invariants.subject_government: ordinary vassals use their normal tier-one government reforms
